## Coverage / conformance

- conformance:

The PR title must be a [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
(`feat`, `fix`, `perf`, `refactor`, `docs`, `test`, `ci`, `build`, `chore`,
`conformance`; optional scope `rest` / `auth` / `realtime` / `storage` /
`functions` / `pooler` / `meta` / `studio` / `judge` / `coverage` / `site`).
PRs are squash-merged; the title becomes the changelog entry.
